criteria: Given --write and --tickets pointing to <externalRoot>/.adlc/tickets.json outside cwd, when runPrune executes, then acquireLock and releaseLock are called with <externalRoot> so <externalRoot>/.adlc/tickets.lock guards the file being written.

Given --write and --tickets pointing to a legacy JSON file that is not named tickets.json inside a .adlc directory, when runPrune executes, then it returns ok: false with an error refusing to lock outside a canonical .adlc/tickets.json store.
intent: Resolve #784: packages/ticket-prune/lib/run.mjs acquires and releases <cwd>/.adlc/tickets.lock even when --tickets points to an external legacy tickets.json file. Derive the legacy store root from absTicketsPath when it resides at <root>/.adlc/tickets.json, reject --write on legacy override paths outside a .adlc/tickets.json layout, and lock the target store root.
title: fix(ticket-prune): derive legacy --write lock root from absTicketsPath and reject non-canonical override paths
